---
title: "Declaration and quality assurance"
lang: en
---
A declaration is based on the specified assessment method, declaration values and supporting project information. The model may permit additional assumptions; those do not automatically form part of the klimaaktiv declaration.

## Assessment levels

The standard distinguishes the Positive Energy District assessment, the mobility extension and the climate-neutral assessment including life-cycle GHG emissions. Check the applicable method and tool version before preparing evidence.

::: {.declaration-note}
**Declaration values:** these are mandatory for the declaration, while the model can be varied for other analyses. This distinction also applies to hourly conversion factors, plug loads and internal gains. PV life-cycle emissions can be modelled but are not included in the current klimaaktiv assessment method.
:::

## Quality assurance {#quality-assurance}

The **AUDIT** worksheet identifies deviations from declaration assumptions for the current variant. Review every finding, trace it to its input and record the rationale and supporting evidence.

::: {.excel-operation}
### Review checklist
1. Confirm project, variant and tool version.
2. Check the declared reference areas and input data sources.
3. Review the AUDIT deviations and distinguish intentional scenario choices from data errors.
4. Verify recalculation status and the relevant [Results](results.qmd).
5. Document unresolved deviations and the basis for any accepted interpretation.
:::

An AUDIT deviation is a review item; its presence does not automatically establish that the model is erroneous or that an exception is acceptable. A current AUDIT worksheet view is still required for field-level instructions.

## Evidence and traceability

Retain the source workbook, project exports, tool version, variant definitions, data sources, calculation state and relevant result tables. For [migration](migration.qmd), archive the original project export. For batch runs, record scenario selection and completion status.

::: {.pending}
Current declaration output, AUDIT and evidence views are needed to document the exact report fields and acceptance workflow.
:::
